run_calibrate_scale: run the calibrate_scale function to compute per-frame depth scales using COLMAP dense reconstruction
prepare_colmap_color: prepare color input images for COLMAP by masking dynamic objects with segmentation masks
make_camera_params_from_colmap: extract camera intrinsics and extrinsics from a COLMAP sparse reconstruction binary model
visualize_calibration_pair: visualize a pair of frames by warping one color image to another using depth and camera params
check_frames: check if all expected output frame files exist in a destination directory matching a source directory
